content: We frame the Medication Regimen extraction problem as a Question Answering (QA) task, which forms the basis for our first approach. It can also be considered as a specific inference or relation extract task, since we extract specific information about an entity (Medication Name), hence our second approach is at the intersection of Question Answering (QA) and Information Extraction (IE) domains. Both the approaches involve using a contiguous segment of the transcript and the Medication Name as input, to find/infer the medication's Dosage and Frequency. When testing the approaches mimicking real-world conditions, we extract Medication Name from the transcript separately using ontology, refer to SECREF19.
